outcome: Decision-making experience regarding trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
Actual choice of TOLAC or elective repeat cesarean birth (ERCB)
Knowledge of risks and benefits of TOLAC versus ERCB
Satisfaction with the intervention and outcome
cohort: 22 women who had a previous cesarean and were candidates for a TOLAC, receiving prenatal care from nurse-midwives at Boston Medical Center
finding: While the scripted counseling did not appear to influence preferred mode of birth, it increased women's perceived knowledge about TOLAC and helped them follow through with their prenatally chosen mode of birth.
mod_finding: Women who received scripted counseling were more likely to feel informed about TOLAC and follow through with their chosen mode of birth, although the intervention did not influence their preference for TOLAC or ERCB.
